Name: Friendship Never Decays
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]

What's more to say? The friendship levels of everyone, including animals, will never decay, even if you ignore them for years. The creation of this mod was inspired by the Friends Forever mod by IsaacSDev which is no longer being updated. Since the 1.6 update, I have been having issues with this mod and the recompiles which prompted me to create this mod. Specifically, the other mods no longer prevented friendship decay with spouses (due to a config file creation error) or animals (due to game changes). With this mod, those problems have been removed and friendship will never decay with anyone.

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Simply, download the mod via a mod manager for automatic installation or download manually, ensure the compressed file is placed within the Stardew Valley\mods folder, extract all from the compressed file in the same location, and you are good to go.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]You do [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]not[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] need to start a new game to add this mod to your game.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content [/color]


[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Friendship doesn't decay.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][u]Villagers:[/u][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Normally, villagers experience friendship decay if you do not interact with them and their friendship is not maxed (<10 hearts or <8 hearts for marriage candidates).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]With this mod, friendship for villagers will not decay even if you do not interact with them when their friendship is below maximum.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Villagers at maximum friendship still experience no friendship decay[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]No impact on friendship gain or friendship loss via giving disliked/hated gifts, rummaging through trash cans, or heart events[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Configurable in config.json (See Configuration section)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][u]Non-Spouse Partners:[/u][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Same as villagers[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Non-spouse partners normally experience friendship decay when not interacted with unless they have reached 10 hearts[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]With this mod, their friendship decay will not decrease even if their friendship is not maxed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]No impact on friendship gain or friendship loss via giving disliked/hated gifts, rummaging through trash cans, or heart events [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Configurable in config.json  (See Configuration section)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][u]Spouses:[/u][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Without this mod, spouses experience decay when not interacted with over time even when their hearts are maxed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]With this mod, that friendship decay no longer exists[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]No impact on friendship gain or friendship loss via giving disliked/hated gifts, rummaging through trash cans, or heart events [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Configurable in config.json  (See Configuration section)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][u]Farm Animals:[/u][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Farm animals normally experience friendship decay if not interacted with. Farm animals also need to be fed in order to increase friendship.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]With this mod, not interacting with farm animals will not result in friendship decay[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Not feeding animals will, by default, lead to friendship loss[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Configurable in config.json  (See Configuration section)[/color][/*]
[/list][u]Pets:[/u]
[list]
[*]Pets experience no friendship decay normally and are not impacted by this mod[/*]
[/list][center][b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b][/center]

Configuration can be done in the config.json file in the FriendshipNeverDecays mod file. You can find this file located within the Stardew Valley game file under the Mods section. Please post if you are having trouble locating this file.

The config.json file includes several options:
[list=1]
[*][u]AnimalsMustBeFed [/u]- Set to true by default, meaning animals that are [b]not fed[/b] will experience friendship loss[/*]
[*][u]SpousesCanLoseHearts[/u] - Set to false by default, meaning that spouses will [b]not [/b]experience friendship decay when not interacted with[/*]
[*][u]DatesCanLoseHearts[/u] - Set to false by default, meaning that dates will [b]not[/b] experience friendship decay when not interacted with[/*]
[*][u]VillagersCanLoseHearts[/u] - Set to false by default, meaning that villagers will [b]not [/b]experience friendship decay when not interacted with[/*]
[*][u]FarmAnimalsCanLoseHearts[/u] - Set to false by default, meaning that farm animals will [b]not[/b] experience friendship decay when not interacted with[/*]
[/list]
To modify these settings, simply change "true" to "false" or "false" to "true" for the setting you wish to change.

[center][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/center]

Works with Stardew Valley Expanded. Not currently tested with other mods, though it should have no impact on mods that do not modify the friendship system. Please let me know if you experience any issues!

[/center]
